mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and increasing the present value of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is in the bottom 25% of its historical range is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when UNRATE > 4.0 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 50th percentiles indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 50th percentiles is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST*RSAFS) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a normal growth regime (INDPRO annual growth rate > 1.5%), a higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns in the regime where INDPRO annual growth > 1.5% is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the average 20-day return in that regime is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, supporting broader economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for HOUST as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns or the average 60-day return when HOUST is in the top 25% of its historical range is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 50th percentile and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below its 50th percentile indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when PAYEMS > 50th percentile and UNRATE < 50th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS * (1-UNRATE)) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth rate > 2.5%), a decline in quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5% and GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 0% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the quarterly growth rate in this regime is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
